name: webmcp
description: MCP tool access for browser-based LLM chat UIs

scripts.build: npm run build -w @webmcp/protocol && npm run build -w @webmcp/daemon && npm run build -w @webmcp/extension
scripts.test: npm run test -w @webmcp/daemon && npm run test -w @webmcp/extension
scripts.daemon: npm run build -w @webmcp/protocol && npm run build -w @webmcp/daemon && npm run start -w @webmcp/daemon --
